messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary cluster 'us-west-canary' error-rate spike on /v1/stream. 5xx rate 18% (threshold 2%). Paging olivia (oncall).
olivia: on it. looking at canary dashboard now. thanks for ping.
olivia: raj, can you grab logs from the model-serving pods? i see nginx upstream 502/503 errors mixed in.
raj: grabbing logs. `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-serving --since=10m` -> seeing repeated OOM-ish traces in model-worker: 'kv_cache_alloc failed' then process restart. attaching tail:
raj: ```
[2026-03-15T20:01:12Z] ERROR model-worker: kv_cache_alloc: unable to reserve 256MB: OutOfMemory
[2026-03-15T20:01:12Z] INFO supervisor: restarting child pid=3921 exit=OOM
``` 
raj: notable: this started ~3m after canary rollout completed. rollback window shows small config change in frontdoor middleware.
emma: that config change was the header-queue optimization from PR abcdef1 (merged yesterday afternoon). it touched prefix caching and a small buffer for streaming headers.
emma: rolling it back locally reproduced the OOM for me on a small repro with long-lived streams.
olivia: miguel, any customer tickets yet? need to scope impact.
miguel: support intake shows ~12 alerts from customers in last 8m, all from the same flow: long streaming chat sessions that hit /v1/stream. estimated <1% overall, but for affected tenants it's ~40% errors. i've flagged high-priority tenants.
sloane: ok flags: 1) customer impact limited to streaming route, 2) canary saw ramp to 18% 5xx, 3) root suspicious PR abcdef1. recommendation: revert that single commit in canary, validate, then promote fix to prod if stable.
olivia: agree. plan: 1) revert commit abcdef1 on canary 2) monitor 10m 3) if errors drop <2% promote to prod with canary rollout 20% 4) postmortem.
emma: preparing revert PR now. quick commands:
emma: ```bash
git checkout -b hotfix/revert-header-queue
git revert --no-edit abcdef1
git push origin hotfix/revert-header-queue
hub pull-request -m "revert: header-queue optimization (regression causing kv cache OOM)"
``` 
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: hotfix/revert-header-queue -> us-west-canary
deploy-bot: rollout status: canary pods updated (3/3), starting traffic shift.
raj: watching logs and metrics. initial memory usage per pod back down on new pods.
raj: canary 5xx dropped to 1.6% within 90s. latency stable. good sign.
miguel: customer pings decreasing, one tenant reported immediate recovery.
sloane: i'll draft a short incident note and notify affected tenants (email + support tickets). include rollback commit id: revert of abcdef1 -> new commit 9a7c3b2
olivia: handing off to raj for 1h post-deploy monitoring. i'll go to sleep mode but reachable if it flares. @raj take over pager.
raj: ack. taking pager. will watch 30m then escalate if any regressions.
olivia: thanks team. prepare follow-up postmortem with timeline and proposed fix options: 1) tighter nat limits for kv cache, 2) validate header-buffer growth under long streams in CI, 3) guardrails for experimental flags.
sloane: noted. i'll open the postmortem doc and assign action items.
olivia: closing loop here once 30m clear. marking incident as 'mitigated' for now. :white_check_mark:
